after_adjudication.utc: about 2026-09-28T03:30Z (the report's file modification time is 03:30:26Z; the adjudication stages ended at 02:32:12Z)
after_adjudication.what: route-mapper's final part 1 report (route-mapper-part1-final.md). Off-pin is 8.0% by the per-turn method (06:58Z-00:13Z) and 10.31% by the per-conversation method (24 h ending about 00:13Z), and it depends on load: mostly 0% in hours with peak in-flight 4-8, 16.7% at 12Z (peak 13), 17.4% at 14Z (peak 14) and 21.7% at 16Z (peak 32). Since 01:22Z it was 0 of 66 at peak 7, which the report says is not evidence of a fix. On 20129, 2 turns after the limiter change were both 200 with added_wait_ms 0, but the 18 turns before the change also show 0, so that column may not record limiter waits.
after_adjudication.decision: The affinity-patch acceptance must compare loaded windows (peak in-flight >= 10, or more than about 300 turns/h), and a pre-patch loaded window must be recorded before the patch is applied.
